release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.9

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Spreads stays visible only when the saved license key is RSP-TEST-PRO. A Pro key, the admin key, an enterprise key, a trial, and a computer with no key do not see the button, the help topic, or the step. A recipe that already contains Spread Convert skips that step and continues.

Spreads: Convert can be None, and that is the choice when the tool opens. Horizontal splits left and right. Vertical splits a calendar into the top half, then the bottom half, and only Reader spreads to single pages uses it. Which pages can be Auto, All pages, or Selected pages from the highlight. A cover checkbox can leave a narrow first and last page unsplit. An odd printer-spread count with one trailing blank sets that blank aside and splits the rest. Reader spreads to printer spreads uses the Booklet step for the press sheet, creep, and marks. The Spreads window no longer has its own sheet. A saved Spreads step that already has a sheet still uses it when the recipe has no Booklet step. A Booklet step on the stack still runs on its own.

Mail merge: A CMYK JPEG placed from an Image/PDF field no longer gets a black plate in Acrobat. The Adobe color tag is removed and the invert stays.
